summary: Return a copy of the observer buffer and empty it while leaving registration intact.

tests.name: drains records
tests.input: const o=new PerformanceObserver(()=>{}); o.observe({type:'mark'}); performance.mark('x'); const a=o.takeRecords(); const b=o.takeRecords(); console.log(a.length>=0,b.length);

tests.name: does not disconnect
tests.input: const o=new PerformanceObserver(()=>{}); o.observe({type:'mark'}); o.takeRecords(); performance.mark('later'); console.log('still registered');
tests.expected_behavior: observer remains eligible for later entries
